items.source: Name of the request attribute holding the ServerRequestObservationContext for the current observation.
items.translation: 持有当前观察的ServerRequestObservationContext的请求属性名称。

items.source: Get the current observation context from the given request, if available.
items.translation: 从给定的请求中获取当前的observation context（如果可用）。

items.source: observationRegistry - the registry to use for recording observations
items.translation: observationRegistry - 用于记录观测的注册表

items.source: Web Frameworks can fetch the current context as a request attribute and contribute additional information to it. The configured ServerRequestObservationConvention will use this context to collect metadata and attach it to the observation.
items.translation: Web 框架可以将当前的 context 作为 request attribute 获取，并向其贡献额外信息。 配置的 ServerRequestObservationConvention 将使用此上下文来收集 metadata 并将其附加到观察中。

items.source: Create an HttpRequestsObservationFilter that records observations against the given ObservationRegistry. The default convention will be used.
items.translation: 创建一个HttpRequestsObservationFilter来记录针对给定ObservationRegistry的观察。将使用默认的convention。

items.source: Create an HttpRequestsObservationFilter that records observations against the given ObservationRegistry with a custom convention.
items.translation: 创建一个HttpRequestsObservationFilter，它会根据自定义约定记录针对给定ObservationRegistry的观察结果。

items.source: Notify this filter that a new Observation.Scope is opened for the observation that was just created.
items.translation: 通知此过滤器，为刚刚创建的观测打开了一个新的 `Observation.Scope`。

items.source: observationConvention - the convention to use for all recorded observations
items.translation: observationConvention - 用于所有记录观测值的约定

items.source: scope - the newly opened observation scope
items.translation: scope - 新打开的观察范围

items.source: response - the filter's response
items.translation: response - 过滤器的响应

items.source: Note that although a filter can be mapped to handle specific dispatcher types via web.xml or in Java through the ServletContext, servlet containers may enforce different defaults with respect to dispatcher types. This flag enforces the design intent of the filter.
items.translation: 注意，尽管可以通过 `web.xml` 将过滤器映射到处理特定分发器类型，或通过 Java 中的 ServletContext 进行配置，但 servlet 容器可能会针对分发器类型强制执行不同的默认设置。此标志强制实施过滤器的设计意图。

items.source:
The default return value is "true", which means the filter will not be
invoked during subsequent async dispatches. If "false", the filter will
be invoked during async dispatches with the same guarantees of being
invoked only once during a request within a single thread.
items.translation: 默认返回值为"true"，这意味着在随后的异步分发中不会调用该过滤器。如果为"false"，则会在异步分发中调用该过滤器，并保证在单个线程的请求中仅被调用一次。

items.source:
Provides HttpServletRequest and HttpServletResponse arguments instead of the
default ServletRequest and ServletResponse ones.
items.translation: 提供 HttpServletRequest 和 HttpServletResponse 参数，而不是默认的 ServletRequest 和 ServletResponse。

items.source: Same contract as for doFilter, but guaranteed to be just invoked once per request within a single request thread.
items.translation: 与doFilter相同的合同，但保证在单个请求线程中每个请求仅被调用一次。

items.source: The dispatcher type jakarta.servlet.DispatcherType.ASYNC means a filter can be invoked in more than one thread over the course of a single request.
items.translation: jakarta.servlet.DispatcherType.ASYNC 类型的分发器意味着在单个请求期间，过滤器可以在多个线程中被调用。
